explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified VAI 51 days after the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the penicillin G potassium shortage on 2023-04-26 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
Our product label identifies Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189) as the registered plant.
FDA inspection 1208260 at that plant ended 2023-06-16 and was classified VAI, 51 days after the shortage posting.
The VAI classification letter for that inspection is dated 2024-09-10, 503 days after the posting.
No FDA action at a registered plant is recorded before the 2023-04-26 posting.
Corvale East holds 11.6 days of injection and 24.3 days of powder; Corvale General holds 15.4 days of injection and 20.6 days of powder.
The rule‑ranked first option is to buy from Athenex Pharmaceutical Division, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
